from.content:
## Star schema

<?claude block dia?>

`fact_question` sits in the middle: one row per puzzle, with a primary key and a foreign key to each dimension on the left. A question can involve many players, clubs or nations (a Clean Sweep list has 20 players), so those join through bridge tables on the right, each with a role saying how the item is used. `fact_answer` holds every accepted answer and wrong option. `fact_schedule` records which day, game and slot used each question, which makes the 8-week reuse rule a simple query. The full schema is 14 tables, all keyed, so any table can be joined to any other.
